title: Nasdaq-100 annual reconstitution announced after the close — the once-a-year NDX membership list, plus that quarter's NDX rebalance, both effective at the 2026-12-21 open
source: EST: date derived by applying the index owner's own published methodology to the 2026 calendar. The methodology is quoted verbatim from Nasdaq's own index methodology PDF, indexes.nasdaqomx.com/docs/methodology_NDX.pdf, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 422,314 bytes, Flate streams inflated and the text layer re-extracted in-session rather than inherited): 'Reconstitution Frequency: Annually ... Reconstitution Reference Dates: Last trading day of November ... Reconstitution Announcement Dates: After the close on the sixth trading day prior to the Reconstitution Effective Date ... Reconstitution Effective Dates: At market open on the first trading day following the third Friday in December.' The SAME table also carries a separate QUARTERLY schedule this proposer read and the 2027 sibling did not name: 'Rebalance Frequency: Quarterly ... Rebalance Reference Dates: Last trading day of February, May, August, and November ... Rebalance Announcement Dates: After the close on the sixth trading day prior to the Rebalance Effective Date ... Rebalance Effective Dates: At market open on the first trading day following the third Friday in March, June, September, and December.' In December the two schedules coincide, so one announcement carries both. Applied to 2026: December's Fridays are the 4th, 11th, 18th and 25th, so the third Friday is 2026-12-18 and the effective date is the next session, MONDAY 2026-12-21; counting back six trading sessions from 2026-12-21 gives 12-18 (1), 12-17 (2), 12-16 (3), 12-15 (4), 12-14 (5) and 12-11 (6), so the announcement lands after the close on FRIDAY 2026-12-11. No US market holiday falls inside that span — Christmas Day 2026-12-25 is a Friday, after the whole window — so no session is displaced. Filed estimate on three counts: the date is a forward application of a standing rule rather than a fetched 2026 Nasdaq schedule; the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no member for an index owner's own published methodology (the same gap every S&P DJI and Russell entry on this calendar records); and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Discovered during the sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-12-21 initial research, checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-12-21 initial research (2026-09-09). THE GAP IS THE POINT: this calendar tracks the 2027 instance as proposals/ndx-annual-reconstitution-announcement-2027-12-10.from-sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-12-20.json and tracks NOTHING for 2026 — the nearer cycle, the one that resolves in 93 days, is the missing one. The 2026 December corridor is otherwise densely covered (22 tracked ids sit within five days of the 2026-12-21 open alone), which is what makes the absence a gap rather than a judgement. WHY THE ANNOUNCEMENT AND NOT THE EFFECTIVE DATE, stated so a later lane does not re-litigate it: the proposer's own panel measured all three sessions of the analogous S&P chain under one method and found the entire index effect sits on the ANNOUNCEMENT session — 410 of 582 constituent rows correctly signed at exact sign p<0.001% and +2.31% mean directional excess, against 256/504 (p=75.5%) on the implementation Friday and 280/548 (p=63.8%) on the effective open. The 2027 sibling separately measured the Nasdaq leg at index level across 21 December cycles and found the effective open a null there too (QQQ relative volume 0.864x mean / 0.898x median, 6 of 21 above 1.0x, the lowest bucket it measured; no December step on its third Friday, MW p=88.9%; excess over SPY 7 of 21 negative, sign p=18.9%). Filing the effective date would put a second measured null on a session this calendar already tracks; filing the announcement puts a date on the session where, in the one family anybody has measured at constituent level, everything happens. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED: any membership names, which do not exist until Nasdaq publishes after the 2026-12-11 close; that the NDX announcement moves NDX constituents the way the S&P announcement moves S&P ones, which is precisely the untested question and needs a constituent-level instrument this house does not own; and any tradeable edge whatsoever — no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped this session for rebalanc|index effect|index inclusion|reconstitut|deletion|witching|closing auction|index flow, zero hits in both), the implied position is half blocked by the house-wide short ban, and 2026-12-11 is a dense session already carrying sp-rebalance-reference-close-2026-12-11, russell-reconstitution-2026-12-11, cr-expiry-2026-12-11 and government-funding-deadline-2026-12-11. Low impact and market-structure only; proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
